Grenada
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Washington or bythe Consulate General in Chicago, USA.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in London.
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Grenada are exempted from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to ninety (90) days in any period of a hundred and eighty (180) days, which means taking into account the period of a hundred and eighty (180) days preceding each day of a stay.
